rationale: The sha256-tie-break representation sensitivity is a separate real-data condition from the historical-corrected run. It must pass the same shared acceptance gate against its own prospective requirements and its own measured-artifact manifest; it must not inherit or overwrite the historical-corrected records. This record binds the declared representation, count unit, ordered identities, per-fold donor provenance and protocol settings for the hash-tie-break condition.
preserved_historical_result: configs/real_paired_acceptance_2026-09-21.json and configs/real_paired_input_manifest_2026-09-21.json are unchanged and remain the historical-corrected condition.

atac.interval_rule: a fragment record qualifies for region [beg, end) when fragment_start < end and fragment_end > beg; fragment_start >= fragment_end records are ignored

regions.rule: per outer fold, top-256 exact intervals by that fold's training-library prevalence; ties broken by sha256('p22-atac-tiebreak-v1' + '\n' + region), then region

population.retained_population: H5AD retained set; unknown barcodes are refused, never silently dropped

protocol.margin_rule: practical_margin(15, 15); not lowered after seeing results

manifest.note: generated after the hash-tie-break ATAC matrix is measured; until it exists no hash-tie-break run may set scientific_claim_allowed
